Name: Dendro Archon Nahida (Project Genshin Farmer Preset) - Fashion Sense (FS)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3]Play as Nahida from Genshin Impact. Commissioned by -Xanthos- as part of my Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires PeacefulEnd's framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to PeacefulEnd.
[/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]Dress up in the unique Dendro Archon attire using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes hairstyle, top, skirt, and two accessories (one animated). 
Hairstyle has a static version, as well as an editable color version.
[/size][size=3]
